conceptSummary: Pollination helps many plants make seeds. Pollen moves from one flower part to another so a new plant can begin.
keyPoints: Bees and butterflies are common pollinators.

vocabulary.exampleSentence: Pollen can stick to a bee.

vocabulary.definition: A sweet liquid inside some flowers.
vocabulary.exampleSentence: The bee drinks nectar from the flower.

vocabulary.definition: The movement of pollen so a plant can make seeds.
vocabulary.exampleSentence: Pollination helps the flower make seeds.

quizQuestions.question: What is pollen?
quizQuestions.explanation: Pollen is a tiny powder made by flowers.

quizQuestions.question: What can a pollinator do?
quizQuestions.explanation: A pollinator moves pollen between flowers.

quizQuestions.question: Why is pollination important?
quizQuestions.explanation: Pollination helps many plants make seeds.

cards.heading: What Moves
cards.body: Pollen moves from one flower part to another.

cards.heading: Who Helps
cards.body: Bees, butterflies, wind, and other helpers can move pollen.

cards.heading: Why It Matters
cards.body: Seeds can grow into new plants.
